math.coverage: The three Area words (Area, Square Unit, Multiply) and finding the area of rectangles by counting square units or multiplying the length and the width.
math.instructions: Answer each question. You can go back before you finish. There are no hints during the test. You will see your score and the answers at the end.
math.note: The class test on Tuesday, Nov 3 is a vocabulary test on Area, Square Unit and Multiply. This Study Scoop practice test checks those words and using them to find area.

items.prompt: What does "Area" mean?

options.text: a square that is 1 unit tall and 1 unit wide
options.why: That is what "Square Unit" means.

options.text: to find the area of a rectangle, you multiply the length and the width
options.why: That is what "Multiply" means.

options.text: number of unit squares needed to cover the INSIDE of a shape or region

items.explain: "Area" means: number of unit squares needed to cover the INSIDE of a shape or region.

items.explain: "Square Unit" means: a square that is 1 unit tall and 1 unit wide.

items.prompt: True or false? To find the area of a rectangle, you subtract the width from the length.

options.why: It is false. You multiply the length and the width.

items.explain: False. "Multiply" means: to find the area of a rectangle, you multiply the length and the width.

items.prompt: True or false? A square that is 1 unit tall and 1 unit wide is one square unit.

options.why: It is true. That is exactly what a square unit is.

items.explain: True. "Square Unit" means: a square that is 1 unit tall and 1 unit wide.

items.prompt: A tablet screen is covered by 20 unit squares, so its ___ is 20 square units.
items.explain: "Area" means: number of unit squares needed to cover the INSIDE of a shape or region.

items.prompt: Each small square is 1 square unit. What is the area of the rectangle?
items.explain: 2 rows of 4 squares: 2 × 4 = 8 square units.

items.prompt: Each small square is 1 square unit. What is the area of the rectangle?
items.explain: 3 rows of 4 squares: 3 × 4 = 12 square units.

items.prompt: Each small square is 1 square unit. What is the area of the rectangle?
items.explain: 2 rows of 6 squares: 2 × 6 = 12 square units.

items.prompt: Each small square is 1 square unit. What is the area of the rectangle?
items.explain: 5 rows of 3 squares: 5 × 3 = 15 square units.

items.prompt: Each small square is 1 square unit. What is the area of the rectangle?
items.explain: 3 rows of 7 squares: 3 × 7 = 21 square units.

items.prompt: This rectangle is 7 units long and 4 units wide. What is its area in square units?
items.explain: Length × width: 7 × 4 = 28 square units.

items.prompt: This rectangle is 5 units long and 6 units wide. What is its area in square units?
items.explain: Length × width: 5 × 6 = 30 square units.

items.prompt: A classroom rug is 8 feet long and 5 feet wide. What is the area of the rug in square feet?
items.explain: 8 × 5 = 40, so the rug covers 40 square feet.

items.prompt: A picture is 6 inches long and 6 inches wide. What is the area of the picture in square inches?
items.explain: 6 × 6 = 36, so the area of the picture is 36 square inches.

items.prompt: Which way finds the area of a rectangle that is 9 units long and 2 units wide?

options.why: Adding the length and the width does not find the area.
That adds the sides around the outside. Area covers the inside, so multiply.

items.explain: Multiply the length and the width: 9 × 2 = 18 square units.
